method: Read-only. Live GET of every URL in the Yoast sitemaps (405) + 29 published posts/pages missing from the sitemap + /סרטונים/ (434 URLs), then every internal link target found on those pages (290 more URLs), via Supabase pg_net from Frankfurt. Redirects detected by Location / X-Redirect-By headers (pg_net follows redirects). Timing by timeout ladder (each URL requested with timeouts 300..8000 ms; the smallest timeout that succeeded = full download time). No write calls to WordPress.
limitations: The exact URL lists behind Ahrefs counts (noindex 23, became non-indexable 20, title/SERP mismatch 8, dropped from top 10 8, organic traffic dropped 12) are only visible in the Ahrefs UI; lists below are live re-checks and GSC-based candidates.
Ahrefs crawl state may differ from today (site changes daily, WP Rocket cache was purged this morning).
TTFB cannot be separated from download time with pg_net; numbers are total HTML download time incl. TLS from Frankfurt, under parallel load.
